window_text.11: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,
window_text.12: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.

question: Why do the seven sons run out of the house?
answer: because the man with the evil spirit beat them
competitor: because they told the spirit to leave

window_text.13: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, “In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out.”
window_text.14: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
window_text.15: One day the evil spirit answered them, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?”
window_text.16: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.
